records.name: Ultra Instinct -Sign-
records.use_race_requirement: Not available as a retail CaC Awoken Skill
records.reason: The current retail Awoken Skill reference lists Ultra Instinct as the universal CaC form but does not list Ultra Instinct -Sign- among CaC Awoken Skills. Current skill/mod references treat Sign as Goku's character form rather than a retail equippable CaC transformation; CaC Sign implementations are presented as mods.

note: Do not encode Ultra Instinct -Sign- as Universal merely because third-party guides may incorrectly call it a shared form. The maintained CaC Awoken dataset should distinguish the retail Ultra Instinct Awoken Skill from Goku's Ultra Instinct -Sign- character state.
